description: Add safe homepage critical CSS, load the full stylesheet without blocking first paint, preserve CSP and no-JavaScript behavior, and verify with local Chrome and PageSpeed-compatible audits.

comments.text: Implemented a homepage-only 24 KB critical CSS bundle (5.4 KB gzip), a CSP-safe non-blocking full stylesheet loader, and a no-JavaScript fallback. Full app.css remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Local Lighthouse mobile and desktop render-blocking audits now pass. Full tests, compilation, formatting, Credo, and asset builds pass.

title: Eliminate homepage render-blocking CSS
